metadata.case_name: GURUNG DURGA BAHADUR v. KAM TAI CONSTRUCTION CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: light duty cleaning worker or a petrol station attendant

injuries.description: multiple fractures of the right transverse processes of the first to fourth lumbar vertebrae
source: According to the reports of the Government hospitals, Mr. Gurung suffered multiple fractures of the right transverse processes of the first to fourth lumbar vertebrae.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: haematoma of about 2.5 cm in diameter over the right side of the occiput
source: There was a haematoma of about 2.5 cm in diameter over the right side of the occiput.
the doctor in the Department of Neurosurgery diagnosed of a post-concussion syndrome.

injuries.description: mild to moderate hearing loss at his right ear (ENT report dated 19 April 2004); prescribed a hearing aid
source: According to the report of the ENT Department from TMH dated 19 April 2004, Mr. Gurung was found to be suffering from mild to moderate hearing loss at his right ear. He was prescribed with a hearing aid.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

manifestations.description: residual lower back pain and stiffness
limping disability; walks with a very noticeable limp and requires a walking stick
headache near the occiput daily, lasting 1 to 2 hours

treatments_received: physiotherapy (20 sessions: ice, electrotherapy, thermal, exercise therapy)

losses.description: Permanent residual lower back pain and stiffness resulting from fractures of the transverse processes of L1 to L4.
Severe limp and requirement of a walking stick for ambulation.
Unable to return to pre-accident employment as a labourer; limited to light duty unskilled work.

comparable_cases.injury_description: fall through a height of 2.4 m and fracture of the transverse processes at L2, L3 and L4
